# Justin Snider — weregoingplaces.xyz

> Personal site of Justin Snider, an SEO/AEO/ASO Lead based in Boston, MA. Sixteen years at the intersection of organic growth and generative search; currently leading SEO/AEO/ASO at OG.com (the prediction-market arm of Crypto.com). Previously: Crypto.com, Binance.US, Public.com, Finder.com, Victorious SEO, Credit Karma. Building agentic content workflows, MCP servers, and Knowledge Graph authority strategies for the retrieval-augmented web.

- [Writing](https://weregoingplaces.xyz/writing/): Long-form essays and field reports on SEO, AEO, agentic systems, and the retrieval-augmented web.

## Latest writing

- [The retrieval-augmented web is already here](https://weregoingplaces.xyz/writing/retrieval-augmented-web): Field report from eighteen months on the SEO/AEO frontier. Covers what changed when AI assistants became a measurable traffic source, what AEO actually means in practice, the agentic content stack at scale (1,000 pieces/quarter across 24 markets), three things that worked, three things that didn't, and what to do tomorrow.

- App Store Optimization (ASO)
